actions.label: Serve Marius — accept an appointment
reasons: The appointment is already claimed or closed.
actions.description: Claim the finite administrative service. Marius may grant revocable protection at reckoning. Fulfil the obligation during Nights 4–5 or lose it.

actions.label: Accept Seraphine’s sanctuary covenant
reasons: First file your Library title or secure the dossier.
The sanctuary offer is unavailable or expired.
actions.description: Requires a filed title or secured dossier. Pay 0.02 Sandbox NEAR for seven nights of non-revocable sanctuary access; no ownership. Offer closes after Night 3.

actions.label: Fulfil the administrative obligation
reasons: Requires active patron protection and an unfulfilled obligation during Nights 4–5.
actions.description: Requires Marius’s protection, Nights 4–5. Cost 1 Blood and this night’s opportunity; retains the revocable patron relationship.

actions.label: Secure the contested archive dossier
reasons: No available archive lead; dossier claimed or deadline passed.
actions.description: Cost 1 Blood. Requires Mirelle’s public lead; compete with Dorian. Opens sanctuary negotiations but grants no right.

actions.label: Commission Lucien’s escape passage
reasons: Requires a public lead and an unclaimed passage before Night 4.
actions.description: Requires Mirelle’s lead. Lucien may delegate temporary protection until Night 6; this is a bridge, not an ending.

actions.label: Give Mirelle Library access
reasons: There is no time left for a new investigation.
actions.description: Let Mirelle bring Cassian to investigate. Her findings can satisfy Marius’s service and earn institutional protection. You may revoke your permission and its dependent grants.

actions.label: Give Dorian Library access
reasons: There is no time left for a new investigation.
actions.description: Let Dorian bring Lucien into your Library. His findings can earn Lucien’s lasting protection. Both gain access under your authority; published findings cannot be recalled.

actions.label: Withdraw your Library permission
reasons: No permission of yours remains to withdraw.
actions.description: Remove the access you granted and its dependent permissions. Unfinished research stops. Published findings and unrelated patron protection remain.

actions.label: Give Marius a continuing invitation
actions.description: One major action. Give Marius non-delegable Library access without expiry; keep his revocable protection.

actions.label: Refuse Marius’s demand
actions.description: One major action. Marius will withdraw his own protection at this reckoning. Independent shelter remains; without it you may lose.

actions.label: Offer a limited inspection
actions.description: One major action and 1 Blood. Give Marius a two-night Library invitation covering the final night, even if he refuses. He evaluates the public account and Cassian’s separate passage; rejection costs his protection.

actions.label: Feed discreetly
actions.description: +4 Blood (maximum 12), +2 transitional Exposure

actions.label: Rest in the Crypt
reasons: crypt: Permission revoked or expired; no other effective access right.
actions.description: +2 Blood, −1 Exposure; requires Crypt access

actions.label: Lie low
actions.description: Cost 1 Blood; −3 Exposure

actions.label: Investigate your Library title
actions.description: Cost 1 Blood; publicly file your verified Library title to qualify for sanctuary negotiations. This grants no rights.

actions.description: Free information: inspect this record once; rereading it is always free.
